description: The person's tracks (sheets), each with its id, link, columns, the hacks that fill it (each with its state: On, Off, Stopped matching, or Paused when it's over the plan's limit) and this week's numbers, plus the Google account you're connected to (signedInAs) and their TrackerHacker email address for forwarding. Call this first.
name: list_tracks
